subject: science
title: Material Detectives
objective: Describe familiar materials by observable properties and choose safe uses or handling.
introduction: Milo has a new mission! 🐱✨ Observe materials without tasting or touching unknown substances. Properties include hardness, flexibility, shine, texture, and whether a material absorbs water. Ready to explore?
